title.narrative: Mamoni Maternal and Newborn Care Strengthening Project (MNCSP) Activity

description.narrative: (Bangladesh): The MaMoni Maternal and Newborn Care Strengthening Project (MNCSP) will reduce maternal and neonatal mortality and increase contraceptive prevalence by strengthening health systems and facilities to provide quality maternal and newborn health care and postpartum FP and nutrition services. With FY 2022 funds, MaMoni MNCSP will target vulnerable population groups in hard-to-reach geographies with poor maternal and newborn care indicators. This activity will continue to improve health system responsiveness to deliver quality services, improve access and demand for care, strengthen governance, healthy household practices, and the national capacity to scale-up evidence-based care. The activity will support the institutionalization of comprehensive emergency obstetric and newborn care, management of sick newborns, midwifery care in select district and sub-district health facilities, and will strengthen the capacity of service providers to manage complications and screen for obstetric fistula. The activity will further enhance newborn care at all levels, including essential newborn care through special care newborn units, helping babies breathe, chlorhexidine use for cord care, and kangaroo mother care. The activity will also increase FP services, focusing on postpartum FP. In addition, MaMoni MNCSP will improve the quality of nutrition counseling during pregnancy and lactation and demonstrate early initiation of breastfeeding after birth. The activity will train service providers on these nutrition issues and counsel key family members to support the mother. This activity will contribute to adaptation-indirect (MCH-$600K, FPRH-$300K), micronutrients (Nutri-$80K of which $80K is for micronutrients Vit A) earmarks.
